results.description: Monster Labs' Controlnet QR Code Monster v2 For SD-1.5 on top of AnimateDiff Prompt Travel (Motion Module SD 1.5 v2)

loop.title: Loop
loop.description: Flag to loop the video. Use when you have an 'infinitely' repeating video/gif ControlNet video

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Seed for different images and reproducibility. Leave blank to randomise seed

width.title: Width
width.description: Width of generated video in pixels, must be divisable by 8

frames.title: Frames
frames.description: Length of the video in frames (playback is at 8 fps e.g. 16 frames @ 8 fps is 2 seconds)

height.title: Height
height.description: Height of generated video in pixels, must be divisable by 8

context.title: Context
context.description: Number of frames to condition on (default: max of <length> or 32). max for motion module v1 is 24

clip_skip.title: Clip Skip
clip_skip.description: Skip the last N-1 layers of the CLIP text encoder (lower values follow prompt more closely)

base_model.description: Choose the base model for animation generation. If 'CUSTOM' is selected, provide a custom model URL in the next parameter

prompt_map.title: Prompt Map
prompt_map.description: Prompt for changes in animation. Provide 'frame number : prompt at this frame', separate different prompts with '|'. Make sure the frame number does not exceed the length of video (frames)

head_prompt.title: Head Prompt
head_prompt.default: masterpiece, best quality, a haunting and detailed depiction of a ship at sea, battered by waves, ominous,((dark clouds:1.3)),distant lightning, rough seas, rain, silhouette of the ship against the stormy sky
head_prompt.description: Primary animation prompt. If a prompt map is provided, this will be prefixed at the start of every individual prompt in the map

tail_prompt.title: Tail Prompt
tail_prompt.description: Additional prompt that will be appended at the end of the main prompt or individual prompts in the map

output_format.description: Output format of the video. Can be 'mp4' or 'gif'

guidance_scale.title: Guidance Scale
guidance_scale.description: Guidance Scale. How closely do we want to adhere to the prompt and its contents

controlnet_video.title: Controlnet Video
controlnet_video.description: A short video/gif that will be used as the keyframes for QR Code Monster to use, Please note, all of the frames will be used as keyframes

film_interpolation.title: Film Interpolation
film_interpolation.description: Whether to use FILM for between-frame interpolation (film-net.github.io)

prompt_fixed_ratio.title: Prompt Fixed Ratio
prompt_fixed_ratio.description: Defines the ratio of adherence to the fixed part of the prompt versus the dynamic part (from prompt map). Value should be between 0 (only dynamic) to 1 (only fixed).

custom_base_model_url.title: Custom Base Model Url
custom_base_model_url.description: Only used when base model is set to 'CUSTOM'. URL of the custom model to download if 'CUSTOM' is selected in the base model. Only downloads from 'https://civitai.com/api/download/models/' are allowed

num_interpolation_steps.title: Num Interpolation Steps
num_interpolation_steps.description: Number of steps to interpolate between animation frames

enable_qr_code_monster_v2.title: Enable Qr Code Monster V2
enable_qr_code_monster_v2.description: Flag to enable QR Code Monster V2 ControlNet

controlnet_conditioning_scale.title: Controlnet Conditioning Scale
controlnet_conditioning_scale.description: Strength of ControlNet. The outputs of the ControlNet are multiplied by `controlnet_conditioning_scale` before they are added to the residual in the original UNet

qr_code_monster_v2_guess_mode.title: Qr Code Monster V2 Guess Mode
qr_code_monster_v2_guess_mode.description: Flag to enable guess mode (un-guided) for QR Code Monster V2 ControlNet

qr_code_monster_v2_preprocessor.title: Qr Code Monster V2 Preprocessor
qr_code_monster_v2_preprocessor.description: Flag to pre-process keyframes for QR Code Monster V2 ControlNet
